scripts.build: bun run build:pypi && bun run build:conda
scripts.build:pypi: cd ../.. && pixi run -e build python scripts/release.py build-python --outdir packages/qgis-sdk-python/dist/pypi
scripts.build:conda: pixi exec -c conda-forge --spec 'rattler-build>=0.77,<0.78' rattler-build build --recipe recipe.yaml --output-dir dist/conda -c conda-forge
scripts.test: cd ../.. && pixi run -e default pytest -c packages/qgis-sdk-python/pyproject.toml packages/qgis-sdk-python/tests .agents/skills/skill-creator/tests
scripts.coverage: cd ../.. && pixi run -e default pytest -c packages/qgis-sdk-python/pyproject.toml packages/qgis-sdk-python/tests --cov=packages/qgis-sdk-runtime/src/qgis_sdk --cov=packages/qgis-sdk-tools/src/qgis_sdk_tools --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=lcov:packages/qgis-sdk-python/coverage/lcov.info --cov-fail-under=90
